prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: photography posing reference atlas for adult female characters.
Create polished detailed 2D anime-adjacent illustrations with mature adult faces, natural adult proportions, clean readable linework and soft fabric shading, consistent warm ivory background and diffuse natural studio light. EXACT TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, FOUR cells in row-major order, thin straight gray grid rules. Put ONLY exact short ID small black at TOP LEFT of its cell, no other text, inset or watermark. Each cell is ONE final posed composition, no explanatory camera icon, arrows, photographer or duplicated figure.
All people clearly ADULT age28–38, full opaque normal clothing, nonsexual fashion portrait context. Default single character: dark-brown low ponytail or loose low bun, opaque muted teal covered blouse, full charcoal straight trousers and flat closed shoes; modest covered dress only where specifically requested. Exactly two coherent arms and legs per person, correct joints and natural hands with believable occlusion. All visible fingers, held objects, heads, hair and arm outlines fit with generous margins. For cells marked MEDIUM SHOT intentionally frame head through mid-thigh, contain ALL raised arms and phone fully; legs below mid-thigh are outside intended portrait framing. For FULL LENGTH cells show ENTIRE people through complete shoes and every support contact, scale scene to fit all people and props in own cell. No extremity crosses grid lines.
For mirror selfies show ONLY the SINGLE reflected woman as the final image: NO additional real body outside mirror, NO repeated reflection and no second phone. Phone back and camera lenses face viewer in mirror poses. Keep eyes or the stated portion of face visible. For group photos, each person has distinct clearly adult face and own coherent body, all hands and feet belong to the correct person.
PORTRAIT canvas approximately2:3 with four tall portrait cells.
EXACTLY 1 clearly adult women in EACH cell. Ordered cells:
Cell1, ID PP001: MEDIUM SHOT head through mid-thigh. eye-level selfie with cheek-side half-heart. Adult woman, medium-shot framing head through mid-thigh, right hand holds ONE plain phone at slightly above own eye level at extended arm distance, eyes look at FRONT camera, left hand curves into a small HALF-HEART beside left cheek, elbows and all fingers visible, gentle adult smile, phone screen toward woman and back toward viewer. Camera height: 手机略高于眼睛; gaze: 看手机前摄; support: 双脚站立.
Cell2, ID PP002: MEDIUM SHOT head through mid-thigh. selfie with gaze slightly away. Adult woman shown head to mid-thigh, left hand extends one phone diagonally forward around eye level, right fingertips rest lightly on covered blouse just below collarbone, head tilts slightly right and eyes look just PAST phone rather than into it, small relaxed closed-lip smile, full phone and fingertips with margins. Camera height: 手机与眼睛近等高; gaze: 看手机旁侧; support: 双脚站立.
Cell3, ID PP003: MEDIUM SHOT head through mid-thigh. slightly high-angle tucked-chin selfie. Adult woman medium shot, one hand raises phone a LITTLE above crown and angled down toward face, chin gently tucked and eyes look upward at front camera, opposite fingertips tuck one side lock behind ear, no extreme distortion, whole raised hand and phone in cell, mature adult features. Camera height: 手机略高于头顶; gaze: 抬眼看手机; support: 双脚站立.
Cell4, ID PP004: MEDIUM SHOT head through mid-thigh. two-handed landscape selfie framing. Adult woman medium shot, BOTH hands hold ONE smartphone horizontally slightly to right of face near eye height, eyes toward its front camera, elbows bent naturally, phone does NOT cover both eyes or mouth, head mildly turns toward device, all fingers and full phone visible, no extra hand. Camera height: 手机与眼睛近等高; gaze: 看手机前摄; support: 双脚站立.
edit_prompt: Edit this existing 2x2 posing sheet. Change ONLY bottom-right PP004: make that woman, both arms, hands and landscape phone about15 percent smaller within the cell and position them so her ENTIRE raised right-side elbow/forearm outline, all fingertips and phone are inside the right border with at least30 pixels ivory margin. Keep the same horizontal-phone selfie pose, mature face, clothing and intended head-to-mid-thigh framing. PP004 label stays top-left. Preserve other THREE cells PP001 PP002 PP003 entirely, grid position, lighting, canvas size and style. No new objects.

edit_history.reason: Preserve complete hands, head, raised arms or umbrella with clear cell margins.
